largeheadline_431484.line2:
Purpose-built technology.
Patient-centered solutions.

Driven by evidence and relentless passion to solve unmet needs, we're advancing peripheral vascular innovation to save and improve lives.

text.text:
Built on a strong foundation of innovation, high-quality products and rigorous clinical evidence, Inari became one of the defining forces in venous care. Now, as Stryker’s Peripheral Vascular business, that foundation has everything it needs to go further.

We lead fearlessly, with a portfolio that spans the treatment of venous and arterial diseases. We innovate intentionally, designing technology alongside clinicians. And we transform together, expanding access, deepening expertise and raising the standard of care globally.

largeheadline_copy.line1: Peripheral Vascular solutions

text.text:
Pulmonary Embolism (PE)

Products designed to quickly remove clots from the lungs.

text_copy.text:
Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT)

Versatile thrombectomy solutions that remove clot, restore venous flow and support improved patient outcomes.

text_copy_14253335.text:
Arterial Disease Solutions

Purpose-built technologies for acute arterial thrombus removal and limb salvage – restoring perfusion and creating new revascularization pathways for chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI).

text_copy.text:
In-Stent Thrombosis

Specialized solution to clear clot from venous stents, restore blood flow and improve vessel patency.

Small Venous Thrombectomy

Devices designed to remove clots in smaller veins, AV fistulas or grafts – restoring blood flow and enabling continued hemodialysis treatment.

Chronic Venous Occlusions

Innovative solution designed to address challenging venous occlusions, restore blood flow and improve patient quality of life.

largeheadline.line1: Clinical evidence

text.text:
CLOUT Registry

The largest prospective mechanical thrombectomy study in the field of deep vein thrombosis (DVT).

Learn more

DEFIANCE RCT

Randomized controlled trail (RCT) of ClotTriever vs. anticoagulation alone in deep vein thrombosis (DVT).

Learn more

text_copy.text:
FLAME Study

The largest prospective study of interventional treatment in high-risk pulmonary embolism (PE).

Learn more

FLASH Registry

The largest prospective interventional registry of pulmonary embolism (PE).

Learn more

PEERLESS Study

The first randomized controlled trial (RCT) evaluating FlowTriever in the treatment of pulmonary embolism (PE).

Learn more

PEERLESS II Study

Randomized controlled trial (RCT) of FlowTriever vs. anticoagulation alone in acute pulmonary embolism (PE).

Learn more

text_copy_copy.text:
PROMISE I Study

A multi-center, prospective, single-arm study conducted at 7 U.S. centers encompassing end-stage — or "no option" — CLTI patients.

Learn more

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
PROMISE II Study

A multi-center, prospective, efficacy and safety study conducted at 10 U.S. centers encompassing end-stage — or "no option" — CLTI patients.

Learn more

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
ArtixASCEND Study

The first prospective registry of Artix for the treatment of acute lower extremity arterial occlusions.

REVIT Study

The first prospective registry of RevCore for the treatment of in-stent thrombosis.

disclaimer.disclaimer:
Indications For Use

The FlowTriever Retrieval/Aspiration System is indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The FlowTriever Retrieval/Aspiration System is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism. The Triever Catheters are indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion, and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The Triever Catheters are intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism. The Triever Catheters are also intended for use in treating clot in transit in the right atrium, but not in conjunction with the FlowTriever Catheters. The FlowTriever2 Catheter is indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from peripheral blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The FlowTriever2 Catheter is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism (PE). The Triever20 Curve Catheter is used coaxially within the Triever24 Catheter for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion, and/ or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The Triever20 Curve Catheter is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism. The Triever20 Curve Catheter is not indicated for use with the FlowTriever Catheters. The Triever20 Curve Catheter is also intended for use in treating clot in transit in the right atrium, but not in conjunction with the FlowTriever Catheters. The Triever20 Curve Catheter must be used within the Triever24 Catheter. The Triever16 Curve Catheter is indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion, and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The Triever16 Curve Catheter is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism. The Triever16 Curve Catheter is not indicated for use with the FlowTriever Catheters. The Triever16 Curve Catheter is also intended for use in treating clot in transit in the right atrium but not in conjunction with the FlowTriever Catheters. The FlowSaver Blood Return System is used with Inari Medical catheters and sheaths for autologous blood transfusion. The FlowStasis Device is intended for temporary suture retention following a percutaneous venous procedure. The Intri24 Introducer Sheath is indicated to provide a conduit for the insertion of endovascular devices into the vasculature while minimizing blood loss associated with such insertions. The ClotTriever Thrombectomy System is indicated for: (1) The non-surgical removal of thrombi and emboli from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion, and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The ClotTriever Thrombectomy System is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature including deep vein thrombosis (DVT). The ClotTriever Sheaths are indicated for use as a conduit for the insertion of endovascular devices into the vasculature while minimizing blood loss associated with such insertions. The Protrieve Sheath is indicated for use as a conduit for the insertion of endovascular devices into the vasculature while minimizing blood loss associated with such insertions. The InThrill Thrombectomy System is indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of thrombi and emboli from blood vessels, including arteriovenous ﬁstulae and arteriovenous grafts for dialysis access, and synthetic grafts. (2) Injection, infusion, and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel/graft. The InThrill Thrombectomy System is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature. The InThrill Thrombectomy System is not intended for use in deep vein thrombosis (DVT) treatment. The RevCore Thrombectomy Catheter is indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of thrombi and emboli from blood vessels (2) Injection, infusion and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The RevCore Thrombectomy Catheter is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature. The VenaCore Thrombectomy Catheter is indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of thrombi and emboli from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion, and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from blood vessels. The VenaCore Thrombectomy Catheter is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature. 

Review complete Instructions for Use, Indications for Use, Warnings, Precautions, Possible Adverse Effects and Contraindications prior to use of the product. 

Caution: Federal (USA) law restricts this device to sale by or on the order of a physician.
